patterns: Basic one-liner: Economic Survey is published by the Ministry of Finance (asked repeatedly).
APPSC asks specific findings of a named edition: ES 2016-17 (UBI, toilets), ES 2015-16 consumption-driven growth, ES 2018-19 debt repayment principle, ES 2024-25 services HFIs.
Other PSCs ask 'according to Economic Survey 20xx' statement items on fiscal response, FDI trend, services.
App covers CEA-wise signature ideas and lots of ES 2025-26 data; matches the 'finding of edition X' shape well but PYQs never ask CEA names.
